address: 63 Bartholomew Close, City of London, London, EC1A 7BF, United Kingdom
bio: The Scandinavian-style décor, warm colour palette and picture windows overlooking church cloisters create a very handsome and comfortable environment, especially when you add in the gorgeous handmade crockery and confident, affable service. The cleverly compiled and well-balanced set menus provide an immeasurably satisfying experience; prime, seasonal ingredients feature in contemporary dishes that may be quite delicate in their appearance, but deliver plenty of wonderful flavours....
